messages.subject: Error in fmesher.read
parts:
Hi,

I've been getting this error 

Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "manifold") : 
  File '/tmp/RtmpJTqIH0/fmesher4f7f60437394.manifold' does not exist.

I'm running R 4.1.0 on Ubuntu 20.04. 

I've tried all the suggestions from previous posts about this issue, including using locate and setting the call options for mkl and fmesher, downloading the binaries etc. I still get this error.

I'm not sure how to convince R that it should not go to this non-existent temporary file to get the manifold....

thanks,
Sara
